settings.title: Secure checkout
settings.text: Every payment goes through Shopify’s encrypted checkout. We never see or store your card details.

settings.title: Premium quality
settings.text: The same pieces we sell all year, at their best prices of the year.

settings.title: Fast shipping
settings.text: Orders are packed quickly, and tracking details arrive by email.

settings.title: Easy returns
settings.text: Changed your mind? Our return policy explains how to send it back.

settings.title: Exclusive offers
settings.text: Subscribers get early access and offers we don’t post anywhere else.

settings.question: When does the Black Friday sale end?
settings.answer: The sale ends when the countdown on this page reaches zero. Prices return to normal after that.

settings.question: How do I get subscriber-only offers?
settings.answer: Join the list from the welcome pop-up or the form at the bottom of this page. Subscriber offers are sent to your inbox.

settings.question: Can I use a discount code on sale items?
settings.answer: You can enter discount codes at checkout. Whether a code works with sale prices depends on that code’s terms.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Delivery time depends on your location. You’ll see the estimate at checkout and receive tracking by email once your order ships.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: The full terms are on our Return & Refund Policy page, linked in the footer.
